title: Christ the Mediator
definition: Christ the Mediator means that Jesus stands between God and humanity to reconcile sinners to God.
summary: Because He is fully God and truly human, Christ alone can represent God to us and bring us to God.
christFocus: Jesus is the one Mediator who gives Himself as the ransom for sinners.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Because He is fully God and truly human, Christ alone can represent God to us and bring us to God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, trust Him more deeply, and follow Christ with clarity instead of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
